XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: 0 { set ind2 = $FIND(source.AlertText, ":", ind) set apeInfo.issuecode = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, ind - $L(itfErr), ind2 -2 ) set emailMsg = "SendEmailSuccess|SendEmailError" set ind = $LOCATE(source.AlertText, emailMsg) if ind > 0 { $$$TRACE("Send email message") set emailSub = "emailSubject:" set emailBody = "emailBody:" set ind2 = $FIND(source.AlertText, emailSub ) set ind3 = $FIND(source.AlertText, emailBody ) if (ind3 > ind2) { set apeInfo.emailSubject = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, ind2, ind3 - ($L(emailBody) +1) ) set apeInfo.emailBody = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, ind3, *) } else { set apeInfo.emailSubject = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, ind2, *) } if (ind2 > 1) { set apeInfo.messagedata = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, 1, ind2 - ($L(emailSub) +1)) } } } else { // Intersystem error set intSysErr = "ERROR #" set ind = $FIND(source.AlertText, intSysErr ) if ind > 0 { set ind2 = $FIND(source.AlertText, ":", ind) set apeInfo.issuecode = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, ind - $L(intSysErr), ind2 -2 ) } else { set ind = $FIND(source.AlertText, ":") if ind > 0 { set apeInfo.issuecode = $EXTRACT(source.AlertText, 0, ind - 2 ) } } } do ##class(%ZEN.Auxiliary.jsonProvider).%WriteJSONStreamFromObject(stream,apeInfo) do target.HTTPHeaders.SetAt("application/json", "content-type") do target.HTTPHeaders.SetAt(stream.Size, "content-length")]]>
